title: Elasticsearch clusters
description: elasticsearch.cluster: cluster health and shards, nodes (heap, CPU, disk, GC, rejections) and indices.

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant
list.query: SELECT tenant_name AS __text, tenant_id::text AS __value FROM devices_v GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT tenant_name AS __text, tenant_id::text AS __value FROM devices_v GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

list.name: check
list.label: Cluster
list.query:
SELECT device_name || ' / ' || name AS __text, check_id::text AS __value
  FROM check_states_v WHERE tenant_id = '$tenant' AND plugin IN ('elasticsearch.cluster') ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
SELECT device_name AS device, name AS cluster, labels->>'status' AS health, status, last_output
  FROM check_objects_v
 WHERE tenant_id = '$tenant' AND check_id IN ($check) AND gone_at IS NULL AND object_key = 'cluster'
 ORDER BY device_name, name

SELECT device_name AS device, name AS node, labels->>'host' AS host, labels->>'roles' AS roles, status, last_output
  FROM check_objects_v
 WHERE tenant_id = '$tenant' AND check_id IN ($check) AND gone_at IS NULL AND object_key LIKE 'node:%'
 ORDER BY device_name, name

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(m.time, $__interval), (SELECT coalesce(s.object_name, nullif(s.object, ''), s.check_name) FROM metric_series_v s WHERE s.series_id = m.series_id) AS metric, (avg(value)) * 1 AS value
  FROM metrics_raw m
 WHERE m.tenant_id = '$tenant' AND m.check_id IN ($check) AND m.name = 'health_code' AND m.object = 'cluster' AND $__timeFilter(m.time) AND $__interval_ms < 300000
 GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(m.time, $__interval), (SELECT coalesce(s.object_name, nullif(s.object, ''), s.check_name) FROM metric_series_v s WHERE s.series_id = m.series_id) AS metric, (sum(sum) / sum(count)) * 1 AS value
  FROM metrics_5m m
 WHERE m.tenant_id = '$tenant' AND m.check_id IN ($check) AND m.name = 'health_code' AND m.object = 'cluster' AND $__timeFilter(m.time) AND $__interval_ms >= 300000 AND $__interval_ms < 3600000
 GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(m.time, $__interval), (SELECT coalesce(s.object_name, nullif(s.object, ''), s.check_name) FROM metric_series_v s WHERE s.series_id = m.series_id) AS metric, (sum(sum) / sum(count)) * 1 AS value
  FROM metrics_1h m
 WHERE m.tenant_id = '$tenant' AND m.check_id IN ($check) AND m.name = 'health_code' AND m.object = 'cluster' AND $__timeFilter(m.time) AND $__interval_ms >= 3600000
 GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1
